## Critique Reconciliation

_No critique artifacts exist for this session._

## Problem Statement

Find duplicate files in a supplied local directory without changing, moving, or
deleting any of the files being scanned. Produce a report only.

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Observable acceptance criterion | Decision / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Scan the given directory and compare file content hashes | Files with matching content hashes are grouped together | Observed — original Requirements section |
| R2 | Report duplicate paths grouped by matching content hash | On a fixture with two identical files and one unique file, the report contains exactly one group holding the two identical paths and excludes the unique file | Observed — original Validation Contract |
| R3 | Preserve every scanned file unmodified; no deletion, move, or mutation | File count and per-file content hashes are identical before and after the run | D1 (resolved), D2 (resolved) |

## Constraints

- Input is a single supplied local directory.
- Output is limited to the duplicate-group report; no other output or system
  change is in scope.
- No deletion authority exists in this spec (D2).

## Validation Contract

Use a fixture directory containing two identical files and one unique file.

- The report groups exactly the identical pair by content hash and excludes the
  unique file (R2).
- File counts and per-file hashes are identical before and after the run (R3).
- Run the fixture check immediately after implementation; any mutation of a
  scanned file or any incorrect grouping fails the check.

## Authority Boundaries

The executor may read and hash files and write the report artifact. The executor
has no authority to delete, move, or otherwise modify any scanned file (D2). Adding
deletion or any other file-modifying behavior requires a new, explicitly sourced
user decision — it is not an extension of this spec.

## Ambiguities

None remaining. The v1 note "None marked by the old scoring system" is superseded
by the explicit decision record above.
